client_situation_summary: The client operates on a fiscal year from September to August and has an annual budget that fluctuates between $800,000 and $550,000 depending on programs and activities. Currently, the Executive Director (ED) manages all bookkeeping tasks, including day-to-day data entry, payroll processing, and invoicing, while also handling monthly reconciliations with the assistance of an external bookkeeper. The financial committee reviews the books monthly, and the client primarily generates revenue through performance fees, with ticketing outsourced as needed.
client_challenges_summary: The client requires support with monthly reconciliations and audit preparation to ensure backups are uploaded.
The ED is overwhelmed with managing all administrative and bookkeeping tasks.
There is a need for year-end cleanup and more comprehensive bookkeeping support than what the current bookkeeper provides.
The client seeks to create an itemized proposal for additional tasks beyond the current bookkeeper's scope.
current_finance_process: The ED uploads all backups to QBO and handles day-to-day data entry, payroll, and invoicing.
current_finance_team_structure: The finance team consists of the Executive Director and three co-founding directors, all of whom are contractors.
reason_for_engagement: To enhance bookkeeping support and ensure comprehensive financial management.
desired_outcomes: Improved monthly reconciliations for all accounts.
Effective management of accounts receivable and payable.
Timely payroll processing and compliance with CRA remittances.
Preparation of monthly financial statements and custom reporting.
client_priorities: Board reporting and participation in board meetings.

bookkeeping.ap_ar_requirements: Managing accounts receivable and revenue, managing accounts payable and bill payments.

payroll.payroll_frequency: semi_monthly for ED; monthly for 3 directors.

reporting.reporting_requirements: Monthly financial statements, custom reporting, and board reporting.
